A '''KDY corporate-security starfleet''' formed part of [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana's]] defenses, along with an extensive mine field. The fleet kept out military threats as well as corporate spies from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. It was considered to be sizable.<ref name="ICS" />
